question: Recently, who has taken over as president of industry body ASSOCHAM for 2024-25?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sanjay Nayar**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Sanjay Nayar** has officially taken over as the **President** of the industry body **ASSOCHAM** (Associated Chambers of Commerce and Industry of India) for the **2024-25** term.
 
• He succeeded **Ajay Singh**, the Chairman and Managing Director of **SpiceJet**, after the completion of his tenure in **March 2024**.
 
• **Sanjay Nayar** is the **Founder and Chairman** of **Sorin Investments**, an early-stage technology-focused fund.
